topology.description: Reduced forward-wave circuit: posterior touch receptor initiates A27h-like premotor activity; each premotor excites its segment motor pool; shortening-sensitive proprioception excites the next anterior premotor pool.
limitations: Not a complete brain or VNC connectome.
The reduced proprioceptor-to-next-premotor edge is a circuit-level approximation, not a claimed identified monosynaptic connection.
One bilateral longitudinal motor pool represents many neurons and muscles per segment.

parameter_provenance.objective: Produce a stable posterior-to-anterior neural and contraction wave whose adjacent motor-onset phase delays fall inside the Greaney 2026 L1 animal-level p10-p90 bands, while preserving continuous biophysical interfaces.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: The 2.5 s cycle period and reduced relay delays are MODEL_FITTED because the checked-in target supplies phase fractions, not an absolute stride period. Other numeric neural, sensory, activation, adaptation, and contact parameters remain engineering estimates; none is a measured L1 constant.
